name: ZJ Dark Mode Toggle
author: Zaman Javed

sections.description:
ZJ Dark Mode Toggle is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin that adds a dark mode feature to your WordPress website.

It provides a toggle button for users to switch between light and dark modes, improving user experience, especially in low-light environments.

Features

  • Enable/disable dark mode (easily)
  • Toggle button on frontend
  • Custom background and text colors
  • Option to enable on mobile devices
  • Choose toggle position (left or right)
  • Lightweight and fast performance
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zamanjaved-dark-mode-toggle directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Dark Mode Settings from the admin menu.
  4. Enable dark mode and customize colors and settings as needed.
sections.faq:
How do I enable dark mode?

Go to plugin settings and enable the option.

Can I change colors?

Yes, you can customize background and text colors from settings.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, you can enable or disable dark mode for mobile users.
